newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: RESEARCH ALERT - Namhae Chemical a sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Namhae Chemical a sell.

text.p: Ssangyong Securities said on Thursday it had downgraded its rating for South Korea's Namhae Chemical to a "sell" from a "buy".

A Ssangyong statement said the downgrade followed the Ministry of Finance and Economy's decision last week to sell its 45 percent stake in Namhae to the state-backed National Agricultural Cooperative Federation, which is buying fertilisers from Namhae.
Namhae had earlier been due to be sold through an auction.

"Under the stewardship of the federation, Namhae is sure to come under pressure to cut fertiliser prices and its diversification into high value-added specialty chemicals will likely falter," said Kim Sang-bae, an analyst at Ssangyong.
"Without open competitive biddings for the government's stake, the value of the company's real estate and other attractive assets will not be reflected in its share price," Kim said.
The recent surge in international crude oil prices and a weaker won will also raise the company's cost of raw materials, he said.
Namhae shares fell 2,300 won to its limit low of 37,100 won in late Thursday afternoon.
